scope: Position-only local geometry design against immutable native mesh and frozen source. Mathematical feasibility diagnostics do not authorize production edits or validate Full42/Stage6.
immutable: Native V/E/F, vertex identities, face cycles and winding, edge incidence, triangulation convention
UV, material assignments, smooth/sharp attributes, custom-normal state
Weights, bones, joints, RSSF and every protected authority membership
Historical validators and all frozen historical/source assets

hard_fail.predicate: Any change to native identities, cycles, winding, counts, incidence or frozen triangulation.

Zero-area native fan triangle or collapse anywhere on the proposed continuous path. Also audit vector-sum quad area; cancellation with positive fan areas must be separately classified, never hidden by a single quad-area scalar.

Certified material orientation reversal under a declared material-chart/path convention, including a zero signed material Jacobian. A chart-outward normal dot or normal rotation alone is not intrinsic 3D inversion. Require both explicit orientation convention and continuous area checks; absent convention fails certification.
New finite point/segment/area contact between nonadjacent native fan triangles, with exact feature membership, across the entire path.
Any new contact outside the exact native common vertex/segment or legal same-face diagonal. Sharing a vertex/edge is never a whole-pair exemption.
New intrinsic fan overlap or new extrinsic surface crossing. Positive-area coplanar overlap remains illegal even when the faces share a native edge.
An uncertified root, chart singularity, coplanar interval or degeneracy interval cannot be promoted to PASS from endpoint tests or a few samples.

conditional_no_regression.rule: Do not require absolute flag count zero. Freeze chart, camera, native cycle and sampling convention; require no new true3D defect and disclose fixed-view crossing parameters and sharpness. New flag/severity worsening triggers review unless independently ruled structural. An updated SVD chart may be reported separately, never substituted to hide regression.
Remove only the actual shared simplex from collision barrier and active set. Continue finite off-simplex checks. There is no positive pair-wide adjacency distance or clearance floor.
A certified coplanar disjoint pair or exact shared-simplex-only contact is legal. Positive-area overlap is a real defect even if baseline-existing, never a projection-only exemption.

Track native triangle IDs, finite features, connected intersection components and contact extents. No wholesale face-family whitelist. New components or penetration/extent worsening cannot inherit a baseline exemption. Existing true contacts remain independently recorded defects; a local no-new-defect result is not global production safety approval.

warning_human: Reference/surrounding continuity and boundary normal progression
AABB proximity, unsigned distance and plane-extension volume sign used only to activate finite-feature checks

feature_model.shared_vertex: Exclude only the identical native point.
feature_model.shared_edge: Exclude only the actual closed segment, with exact on-segment predicate; no expanded strip.
feature_model.native_fan_diagonal: Same-face diagonal is legal; coplanar fan area overlap remains illegal.
feature_model.2182_3330_specific: Current edge79/955 contact is legal, but same-side coplanar fold limit has positive-area overlap. Retain this finite corner/edge barrier; the active row is not automatically spurious.
feature_model.204_207: Nonadjacent, source gap0.024319952mm; preserve finite vertex/triangle nonpenetration and relative tangent-motion causality.

continuous_collision.broadphase: Swept whole-mesh AABBs for every changed-incident fan, plus explicit same-native-face fan pairs. Unchanged static pairs retain independently recorded source status.
continuous_collision.noncoplanar: Isolate coplanarity roots with certified intervals; verify finite barycentric/edge membership at events. Exact Bernstein sign certificates for complete pair oriented-matroid predicates can instead certify event-free subintervals.
continuous_collision.persistent_coplanar: Certify common plane, use a nonsingular chart, partition all continuous 2D orientation/edge events, clip finite polygons and subtract shared simplex at events and sign-invariant intervals. All-zero 3D volume polynomials do not imply safety.
continuous_collision.rotating_common_plane: Certify a projection-chart atlas and singularity events, or complete rank-3 chirotope sign preservation within a certified chart; require certified algebraic-root isolation on intervals with events.
continuous_collision.implemented_here: Fixed-plane rational-event controls and exact sign-preserving continuous micro certificates. No general-purpose rotating-plane CCD implementation or candidate production validator is claimed.
continuous_collision.unresolved_policy: FAIL_CLOSED_FOR_THE_TRIAL, refine predicate/interval/chart; never endpoint-only PASS.

tolerances.exact_narrowphase: Rational predicates on stored binary64 inputs; no barycentric extension epsilon.
tolerances.old_R3_tolerances: Historical values are reproduced only for comparator results; not silently elevated into anatomy rules.
tolerances.uncertain_float_result: Refine to exact/certified predicates; fail closed if undecidable.

solver_formulation_proposal.objective: Simultaneous dent diagnostic, native hinge progression and frozen reference/surrounding continuity descent; shape completion is a goal, not an impossible infinitesimal terminal threshold.
solver_formulation_proposal.variables: Coupled normal plus both tangents within a separately reviewed local position pool, smooth displacement/gradient/bending metric and immutable outer boundary. Mathematical111-vertex probe support grants no application authority.
solver_formulation_proposal.strategy: Feature-aware nonlinear SQP/trust-region or constrained descent, re-identify closest finite features and contact components after every trial. Keep genuine active off-edge rows, remove pure shared-simplex zero-distance rows.
solver_formulation_proposal.acceptance: Certified continuous true3D nonpenetration/orientation/area; projection-specific no-regression; meaningful objective decrease and boundary checks. A small-step progress heuristic alone cannot establish infeasibility.
solver_formulation_proposal.next_validation: Implement rotating-plane/event root certification and baseline component tracking before candidate safety certification; retain the full negative-control suite and source no-drift check.
solver_formulation_proposal.not_proved: Local micro descent does not prove a complete repair, all-pose nonintersection or natural valley appearance.

negative_control_requirement.required: Every true crossing, same-side shared-edge overlap, intrinsic coplanar bow, material reversal/collapse, degeneracy and persistent-coplanar tunnel must block. Legal shared vertices/edges and the three intrinsic projection-only fans must pass their geometric test.
